text:
[issue by Silverbolt666]
### Minecraft Version

1.20.1

### What happened?

**Curious API encountered am error during the sided_setup event phase**
org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.transformer.throwables.MixinTransformerError; An unexpected critical error was encountered

### How do you trigger this bug?

1. Update to version curios-forge-5.11.0+1.20.1
2. Start the game in a custom moded setting



### Loader

Forge

### Loader Version

47.3.10

### Mod Version

curios-forge-5.11.0+1.20.1

### Relevant Log Outputs

[Curious_latest.log](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/17668260/Curious_latest.log)
[Curious_crash-2024-11-07_19.16.50-fml.txt](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/17668261/Curious_crash-2024-11-07_19.16.50-fml.txt)


Note: have not been able to identify if another mod is causing the error

[comment by TheIllusiveC4 (owner)]
Duplicate of https://github.com/TheIllusiveC4/Curios/issues/344
This is an issue with the Tiered mod.
